snippet.title: How 200,000 German Soldiers Got Trapped in Latvia
snippet.description:
October 1944: the Red Army reaches the Baltic Sea and cuts off Germany's Army Group North in Courland, western Latvia. The navy could
have shipped them home. Hitler said no.

On 5 October 1944 General Ivan Bagramyan's 1st Baltic Front attacked west of Siauliai. Two days after breaking through, its Fifth
Guards Tank and Forty-third Armies reached the coast north and south of Memel (9-10 October), and the 16th and 18th Armies of Army
Group North were cut off in Courland; Riga fell on 13 October. Through the winter Germany's Chief of the Army General Staff, Heinz
Guderian, asked Hitler again and again to bring the army group home by sea to defend Germany. Hitler refused: he argued that the pocket
tied down Soviet armies, and Grand Admiral Dönitz wanted the eastern Baltic as the training waters for the navy's new U-boats. Six
Soviet offensives, the "Courland battles" of October 1944 to April 1945, failed to break the pocket. Some divisions were shipped out
in January-March 1945; the rest were ordered to stay, renamed Army Group Courland, and the last convoys left Liepaja (Libau) on 8 May.
On 9 May 1945 about 189,000 German soldiers, 42 of them generals, surrendered (Soviet count; Russian records by 12 May give about
146,000), along with some 14,000 Latvians; most went into Soviet captivity. From October 1944 to May 1945 the army group had lost about
118,000 men killed, wounded or missing (Frieser), over 150,000 by another estimate (Grier). Today the dead of both armies lie in western
Latvia, in the Soviet war cemetery at Priekule and the German war cemetery at Saldus.

Sources:
- Earl F. Ziemke, Stalingrad to Berlin: The German Defeat in the East (US Army Center of Military History, 1968), ch. XVII-XXI
- Howard D. Grier, Hitler, Dönitz, and the Baltic Sea: The Third Reich's Last Hope, 1944-1945 (Naval Institute Press, 2007)
- Karl-Heinz Frieser (ed.), Das Deutsche Reich und der Zweite Weltkrieg, vol. 8 (2007)
- Gerhard L. Weinberg, A World at Arms (1994); Heinz Guderian, Panzer Leader (1952)
Numbers differ between sources; the video gives rounded figures. The fronts are simplified reconstructions after the US Army's maps.

Maps and imagery:
- Maps: West Point atlas, "Russian Balkan and Baltic Campaigns, Operations 19 Aug - 31 Dec 1944" (Department of History, U.S. Military
  Academy), public domain; "Army Group North Retreats to Courland, 14 September - 23 October 1944" (Map 36), Ziemke, Stalingrad to
  Berlin (U.S. Army Center of Military History, 1968), public domain
- Satellite: Sentinel-2 cloudless - https://s2maps.eu by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016), CC BY 4.0;
  NASA Blue Marble (public domain)
- Borders, rivers, coastlines: Natural Earth (public domain); elevation: SRTM (NASA, USGS) via AWS Terrain Tiles

Photos:
- Ivan Bagramyan, commander of the 1st Baltic Front, 1944: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation (mil.ru), CC BY 4.0
- Lothar Rendulic; Heinz Guderian, 1946: U.S. National Archives, public domain
- Adolf Hitler (Heinrich Hoffmann, National Archives, seized records)

Music: "Volatile Reaction", "Anguish" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

snippet.title: Why This House Rose During a Flood🌧️
snippet.description:
A family that already lost one home to a flood spent every dollar they had on this one. Then the river came up faster than anyone expected, and the whole house started lifting off the ground.

It's an amphibious house. It sits on dry land on a floating foundation: a buoyant base hidden under the floor. Vertical guide posts keep it from drifting. When the water rises, the house floats straight up with it, and when the water goes down, it settles right back where it was. Homes like this exist along the Meuse River in the Netherlands, and researchers in Louisiana have been fitting buoyant foundations under existing houses.

(The family is fiction. The floating foundation is real.)

#shorts #engineering #flood #architecture

snippet.title: The Art of the Seal
snippet.description:
This video explores the O-ring, from the Challenger disaster and Niels Christensen's 1937 patent to the physics, materials and design rules behind one of engineering's simplest seals.

CHALLENGER
· Launch morning was 36°F, far colder than any previous shuttle flight's O-rings had seen.
· Near their glass transition, the stiffened seals couldn't follow the joint as it flexed open.
· A 1mm breach let 5,000°F gas erode the joint until the booster failed at 73 seconds.

ORIGINS
· Edison's 1882 light bulb patent used a rubber ring to seal the neck of the bulb.
· At 68, machinist Niels Christensen began four years of work on hydraulic seals.
· The U.S. government bought out his patent in WWII, and the legal fight outlived him.

HOW THEY SEAL
· Under pressure, an O-ring behaves like an incompressible fluid with very high surface tension.
· It flows into the gland, absorbing tolerance stack-up to create a zero-clearance joint.
· Pushed past its limit, the elastomer extrudes into the clearance gap and the seal leaks.

STATIC SEALS
· Even "static" joints face vibration, so true static seals are rare in real use.
· Liquid seals tolerate surface roughness of up to 0.8 microns, like 320-400 grit sandpaper.
· Lathe-turned scratches along the groove can seal well where cross-milled ones fail.

DYNAMIC SEALS
· Reciprocating seals descend from the steam piston and now seal hydraulic actuators.
· Oscillating seals in faucets reverse direction, while rotary seals turn continuously on shafts.
· Seat seals close a flow path directly, as the O-ring is crushed against a seat.

MATERIALS
· Vulcanization cross-links polymer chains, turning a plastic-like compound into an elastic one.
· Silicone survives -115°C to 232°C but stands up poorly to oils, fuels and tearing.
· Perfluoroelastomer resists almost any chemical up to 316°C, at a much higher price.

SELECTION
· Heat forms new cross-links, leaving the seal unable to recover after compression.
· Static seals can tolerate 25-30% swelling, but dynamic seals become excessive past 10%.
· Shrinkage is never acceptable, because a shrinking seal is a failing one.

SEAL SYSTEM DESIGN
· Cold service calls for shallower glands that keep squeeze on the contracted ring.
· Pressure cycles that swell the cylinder wall can nibble an O-ring away bit by bit.
· Hard nylon back-up rings guard the clearance gap in the most extreme systems.

INSTALLATION
· Lubricant protects the ring during assembly and can lower vacuum leak rates.
· Stretch is held to around 5% to avoid shortening the O-ring's life.
· The gland must close without pinching or twisting the ring at the groove corners.

snippet.title: Mirza, Leyla ve Hüma ile aile fotoğrafı çektiriyor! | Sevdan Bir Ateş 12. Bölüm
snippet.description:
Sevdan Bir Ateş 12. Bölümünde;
“Aile”
Yedi yıllık ayrılığın, acının ve hasretin ardından Leyla, Mirza ve Hüma için nihayet mutluluğun kapıları aralanır! Bütün zorluklara rağmen birbirlerine kavuşan üç kişilik küçük aile, geçmişin karanlığını geride bırakıp yeni bir hayata başlamaya hazırlanır. Küçük Hüma’nın anne ve babasını bir araya getirmek için çıktığı umut dolu yolculuk, Kapadokya’nın büyülü atmosferinde unutulmaz bir kavuşmaya dönüşür!
Ancak Kozaklı ailesinde sular durulmaz! Leyla’yı kurtarmak uğruna ölümün eşiğine gelen Vuslat’ın akıbeti herkesi sarsar. Yaman, Faysal için herkesten gizlediği büyük bir planı hayata geçirirken, Destan ise bütün dengeleri altüst edebilecek gizemli bir videonun peşine düşer!
Bir yanda geçmişin karanlık sırları, diğer yanda yeniden filizlenen büyük bir aşk... Mirza, Leyla ve Hüma’yla yıllardır hayalini kurduğu aileye kavuşmanın mutluluğunu yaşarken geçmişin derin yaraları iki âşığın karşısına beklenmedik bir engel çıkarır.

Murat Ünalmış (Mirza) ile Özge Özacar’ı (Leyla) başrollerde buluşturan dizinin oyuncu kadrosunda Gökçe Eyüboğlu (Mihre), Sitare Akbaş (Destan), Taner Rumeli (Yaman), Sezin Bozacı (Macide), Yeşim Gül (Vuslat), İsmail Hakkı (Cici), Beyti Engin (İrfan), Evren Duyal (Mukaddes), Hande Canpolat (Miray), Yusuf Gökhan Atalay (Tesbihçi), Ceren Taşçı (Fidan), Aslıhan Karalar (Ceren), Yiğit Yalkın (Sefa), Dorukcan Sarıduman (Akif), Süleyman Felek (Mahmut), Azra Sare (Esma), Melih Kırkbir (Ateş), Kayra Sır (Ahu), Ege Gönülal (Yağız), Beyza Karabacak (Hüma) ve Okday Korunan (Çakır) yer alıyor. Soydan Soydaş (Faysal), Sermet Yeşil (Nasim) ve Süreyya Kilimci (Safura) ise diziye konuk oyuncu olarak eşlik ediyor.

snippet.title: ATENCIÓN | Primera REACCIÓN DEL DEPARTAMENTO DE ESTADO de EEUU ante los HECHOS VIOLENTOS EN COLOMBIA
snippet.description:
Se ha conocido la primera reacción desde el Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos sobre los recientes hechos de miedo y violencia que sacudieron a las ciudades de Villavicencio y Cartagena en Colombia.

De acuerdo con la información a la que tuvo acceso en primicia NTN24, la oficina del secretario Marco Rubio ha manifestado que condena rotundamente estas acciones y que hay que seguir luchando contra la criminalidad y el narcoterrorismo.

“Estados Unidos condena enérgicamente estos ataques y se solidariza con el gobierno de De la Espriella y el pueblo colombiano”, se indica.

Así mismo, enfatizaron el compromiso expuesto por Rubio durante su visita a Colombia durante el pasado mes de septiembre, por medio del cual la nación norteamericana manifestó su compromiso de cooperar para combatir “la amenaza regional”.

Para analizarte este tema, el programa Club de Prensa de NTN24 conversó con los analistas Vanessa Vallejo y Josías Fiesco, analistas que han destacado la importancia de esta alianza entre el gobierno de Abelardo de la Espriella y Estados Unidos.

snippet.title: Trump imposes fresh tariffs on major trading partners
snippet.description:
Simon Marks joins Andrew Marr as Trump announces a wave of new tariffs on 14 major trading partners.

China, which Washington blames most for flooding world markets with cheap exports, is expected to be hit with the highest rate.

The new duties follow an eight-month investigation by the US Trade Representative's (USTR) office into 16 trading partners, including close allies Japan, the European Union and South Korea.

The administration said excessive production has led to a flurry of goods at lower prices that undercut US companies.

A senior US official said that tariffs were proposed for goods from China, Bangladesh, Cambodia, the European Union, India, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam.

For the time being, the USTR did not propose tariffs on goods from Mexico and Norway.

snippet.title: ¿Podrían 2 personas realmente reiniciar la humanidad?
snippet.description:
Un martes a las 7:14 de la mañana desaparecen 8,000 millones de personas. Solo quedan dos: Omar, un cocinero con 340 seguidores, y Lucía, una enfermera que está a 400 km… y que dice que él no es su tipo. Pero él es el único tipo. ¿Podrían dos personas realmente volver a llenar el planeta?

En este video hacemos las cuentas de verdad: cuántos hijos puede tener una pareja, cuánto tardaría la humanidad en volver a ser 8,000 millones y por qué el mayor problema no es el tiempo, sino la sangre. Hablamos de los Habsburgo, de la isla de Pingelap, de los guepardos y de la carrera para salvar un banco de embriones congelados a −196 °C antes de que se acabe el nitrógeno. Y, en medio del fin del mundo, también de algo que no estaba en los planes.

⏱️ CAPÍTULOS
0:00 Una mañana sin nadie
0:38 Parte 1 · Un espectador
1:58 Parte 2 · Las cuentas
3:15 Parte 3 · El problema de la sangre
5:51 Parte 4 · Contra el nitrógeno
7:36 Parte 5 · Lo que se olvida
8:51 Parte 6 · El único tipo
10:06 Parte 7 · La respuesta
11:30 30 años después

🔬 DATOS REALES DEL VIDEO
• El récord de hijos registrado es de 69, de la esposa de Feodor Vassilyev (Rusia, siglo XVIII). La cifra es muy discutida (Guinness World Records).
• Cada persona carga, en promedio, poco más de media mutación recesiva que podría matar o dejar estéril a un hijo si le llegara por partida doble (Gao et al., Genetics, 2015).
• Carlos II de España, el último Habsburgo español, tenía un nivel de consanguinidad parecido al de un hijo de hermanos (Álvarez et al., PLoS ONE, 2009).
• En Pingelap, después de un tifón hacia 1775 sobrevivieron unas 20 personas. Hoy casi 1 de cada 10 habitantes no distingue los colores (acromatopsia); en el resto del mundo es 1 de cada 30,000.
• Los guepardos pasaron por un cuello de botella hace unos 10,000–12,000 años y aceptan injertos de piel de guepardos que no son sus parientes (O'Brien et al., Science, 1985).
• Regla 50/500 de la biología de la conservación: 50 individuos para evitar problemas inmediatos y 500 para mantener la variedad a largo plazo (Franklin, 1980).
• Hace unos 900,000 años, los antepasados humanos se redujeron a unos 1,280 adultos reproductores durante más de 100,000 años (Hu et al., Science, 2023).
• Una nave que viajara a otra estrella podría mantener una población sana con solo 98 personas bien escogidas (Marin y Beluffi, 2018).
• En 2022 nacieron en EE. UU. gemelos a partir de embriones que estuvieron congelados unos 30 años.

💬 Y tú, si fueras una de esas dos personas, ¿lo intentarías? ¿O preferirías quedarte solo con tu perro? Te leo en los comentarios.

* ل گوشا سەری راست( یان چەپ ، لدویڤ زمانێ موبایلا تە ) ، کلیک بکە ل سەر ئایکونێ رێک ئێخستنێ (settings- کو ئەڤ شێوەیە ⚙️)
